description: Defines enums and structures related to HTTP parsing states, error codes, and header content length status within the quiche project, specifically for the Balsa HTTP parser component.

classes.name: BalsaFrameEnums
classes.description: Contains enums for HTTP parsing states and error codes, with static methods for converting enum values to strings.

classes.name: BalsaHeadersEnums
classes.description: Contains enum for Content-Length header status.

methods.name: ParseStateToString
methods.description: Converts a ParseState enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: ErrorCodeToString
methods.description: Converts an ErrorCode enum value to its string representation.
